/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/FlowItemView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/WaterFlowView.ets; do echo "--- $f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'15,90p'; done"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in /rules/node_modules/homecheck/lib/checker/performance/RemoveContainerWithoutPropertyCheck.js /rules/node_modules/homecheck/lib/checker/performance/RemoveRedundantNestContainerCheck.js /rules/node_modules/homecheck/lib/checker/performance/RemoveRedundantStateVarCheck.js /rules/node_modules/homecheck/lib/checker/performance/RemoveUnchangedStateVarCheck.js; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in /rules/node_modules/homecheck/docs/remove-container-without-property-check.md /rules/node_modules/homecheck/docs/remove-redundant-nest-container-check.md /rules/node_modules/homecheck/docs/remove-redundant-state-var-check.md /rules/node_modules/homecheck/docs/remove-unchanged-state-var-check.md; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f" 2>/dev/null || true; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/flex/AlignSelfPage.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/flex/AlignSelfStretchNoSizePage.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/flex/AlignSelfStretchPage.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/flex/FlexBasisPage.ets; do echo "--- $f"; rg -n '"'@State|this\\.(containerView|targetView|componentKey|parentComponentKey|referenceComponentKey|parentWidth|parentHeight|targetHeight|targetWidth|compareWidth|compareHeight)' \""'$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "find /rules/node_modules/homecheck -path '*docs*' -type f | sort | rg 'remove-(container|redundant|unchanged).*check' || true; find /rules/node_modules/homecheck -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | head -100"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/markAnchor/NavRouterView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/offset/NavRouterView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/NavRouterView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/NavigationView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/TabsView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/WaterFlowView.ets; do echo "--- $f"; rg -n '"'@State|this\\.(isActive|dex|minSize|maxSize|fontSize|colors|currentIndex)|\\b(isActive|dex|minSize|maxSize|fontSize|colors|currentIndex)\\b' \""'$f"; done'
/usr/bin/bash -lc 'find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -type d -name .git -print; git -C /workspace rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true; git -C /workspace status --short 2>/dev/null || true'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/markAnchor/NavRouterView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/offset/NavRouterView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/NavRouterView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/NavigationView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/TabsView.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/view/position/WaterFlowView.ets; do echo "--- $f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'15,28p'; done"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -c '.selected_rules == (.rules | map(.rule))' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json 2>/dev/null || true; jq -r '.selected_rules[]' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json; test "'! -e .homecheck-target.json && echo '"'temporary config removed'"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq empty .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json && jq -r '[.selected_rules[], (.entity_repairs[].rule)] | length' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json && jq -r '[.entity_repairs[].locations[]] | length' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json && jq -r '[.entity_repairs[] | select(.status "'!= "repaired" or (.entities|length)==0 or (.evidence|length)==0 or (.transformation|length)==0)] | length'"' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json"
